title: Pointwise degreewise exactness of locally constant integer cochains
statement: Let $G$ be a topological group in universe $u$, $\mathcal A$ an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and $E:\mathcal A\simeq\operatorname{DiscreteContinuousRep}_{\mathbb Z}(G)$ [def-exc-discrete-modules-category] with carrier universe $\max(u,s)$. Suppose $C:\mathcal A\to\operatorname{CochainComplex}(\operatorname{Ab}_{\max(u,s)},\mathbb N)$ is an additive functor, with additive equivalences $e_{M,n}:C(M)^n\simeq\operatorname{LC}(G^n,E(M))$, where LC means locally constant functions. Assume that for every coefficient map f, degree n, element x, and tuple g, $e_{N,n}(C(f)^n(x))(g)=E(f)(e_{M,n}(x)(g))$. Then for every short exact complex $S$ in $\mathcal A$ and every $n\in\mathbb N$, evaluation in degree n of $S$ mapped through C is short exact in $\operatorname{Ab}_{\max(u,s)}$. No formula for the differential and no compactness hypothesis are needed.

proof.text: Apply lem-exc-rg-open-stabilizer-adjoint to the integer representation category. Its inclusion U preserves monomorphisms and is a left adjoint. Compose E, U, the representation-to-module forgetful functor and the module-to-abelian-group forgetful functor to obtain F. Mathlib proves these functors preserve finite colimits; F also preserves monomorphisms and zero morphisms. Preservation of binary coproducts gives additivity. Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesMonos_and_cokernels then gives preservation of homology. Apply ShortExact.map to obtain a short exact underlying coefficient sequence. The cited adjunction is a generic categorical tool, and does not replace any step of the blueprint unit.

Extract coefficient injectivity, kernel lifting and surjectivity by ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff and ShortExact.ab_injective_f/ab_surjective_g. For a cochain in the kernel define a set function on the middle coefficient group choosing a preimage of each element in the kernel, and zero elsewhere. Postcompose the cochain with this function using LocallyConstant.map. The coefficient-map formula hm and e transport this lift back to a preimage in the evaluated complex. Injectivity follows pointwise from coefficient injectivity. Surjectivity follows by postcomposing with Function.surjInv of the coefficient surjection. No compactness or finiteness is used, and Fin 0 is handled by the same proof. Use AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective, epi_iff_surjective and ShortExact.mk' to assemble short exactness.

lean.statement: theorem locallyConstantCochains_degreewise_exact (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] (A : Type v) [Category.{w} A] [Abelian A] (E : A ≌ DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, max u s} ℤ G) (C : A ⥤ CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{max u s} ℕ) (e : ∀ (M : A) (n : ℕ), (C.obj M).X n ≃+ LocallyConstant (Fin n → G) (E.functor.obj M).obj.V) (hm : ∀ (M N : A) (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ) (x : (C.obj M).X n) (g : Fin n → G), e N n (((C.map f).f n) x) g = (E.functor.map f).hom.hom (e M n x g)) [C.Additive] : ∀ (S : ShortComplex A), S.ShortExact → ∀ n : ℕ, ((S.map C).map (HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{max u s} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact
